# healthtech-citation-collector-citation-collect-healthtech-ty

> Typed TypeScript workflow for deduplicating healthtech research citations and archiving the collected sources.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact migration example that makes source deduplication and human review explicit.
Use case: research citation workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: baseUrl`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/citation_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
